valuation_template_rationale: Canadian Solar combines minority-owned manufacturing, storage and project-development assets with volatile consolidated earnings, so a discounted attributable-book-value NAV is more decision-useful than a single earnings multiple.
bear_assumptions: Apply approximately 0.25x to March 2026 attributable book value per share if module oversupply and weak normalized margins persist, inventory consumes cash, refinancing and project-sale delays increase, and leverage sustains a deep asset-value discount.
base_assumptions: Apply approximately 0.45x to March 2026 attributable book value per share if storage growth and Cobalt plus other project execution partly offset module weakness, while debt, cash conversion and minority interests continue to limit common-share value realization.
bull_assumptions: Apply approximately 0.65x to March 2026 attributable book value per share if storage scales profitably, projects monetize on schedule, localized manufacturing improves mix, working capital releases and consolidated debt declines.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade requires a mark at or below USD 15.02 plus improved downside payoff, an accepted material relationship and primary evidence of normalized margin, cash conversion and debt reduction. Downgrade if storage growth slows, normalized margin misses guidance, project monetizations slip, inventories or debt keep rising, liquidity tightens or dilution materially increases.
